sentences.en: Concrete can be reinforced by putting steel bars inside it.
sentences.zh: 可以在里面放钢筋来增强混凝土。

sentences.en: This type of concrete has never been used in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 这种类型的混凝土在新加坡从未被使用过。

sentences.en: The collapse of the new concrete platform killed four workers.
sentences.zh: 新的混凝土平台倒塌导致四名工人死亡。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+cret（增长）+e →共同增长而变厚→混凝土
